title: AssetRealization
description: A data asset that physically realizes an ontology concept. Unlike a tag label, which records that an asset merely references a concept, a realization records that the asset stores the instances of the concept.

realizationRole.description: Role the asset plays in realizing the concept. At most one asset may be the primary store of a concept.

id.description: Stable identifier used by drafts and version diffs.

description.description: Human-readable note about how the asset realizes the concept.

provenance.description: How this realization edge originated. Defaults to 'Manual'.
